units.title: 看诊时向成人说清楚需要

materials.title: Clinic Telling Needs 031
materials.text: A child is at a clinic with a parent. Choose the sentence that explains the stated need. These are communication questions, not medical instructions.

questions.prompt: Your ear hurts, and you need to tell the doctor where. What do you say?
questions.explanation: A准确说耳痛部位；B鞋色、C椅形不报告身体需要。

questions.prompt: The name on your card is not yours. What do you say to the helper?
options: This name is not mine. Please check it.
questions.explanation: B说明卡名错误并求核；A全部己名矛盾；C藏卡不纠身份。

questions.prompt: You feel unsure about the next step and want it explained. What do you ask?
questions.explanation: C问下一步求说明；A墙唱、B笔长无关流程理解。

questions.prompt: Holding your teddy helps you feel calm. You want permission to keep it with you. What do you ask?
options: May I keep my teddy with me?
May I take the doctor’s chair home?
May I close the whole clinic?
questions.explanation: A请求随身留安慰玩具；B带医椅、C关诊所不是所需许可。

questions.prompt: A sign has words you cannot read. You ask an adult to read it. What do you say?
options: Could you read this sign to me?
Please put the sign outside in the rain.
questions.explanation: B请求成人朗读获取信息；A擦、C淋湿不帮助理解。

materials.title: Pony Visit Brushes 031
materials.text: On our pony visit, an adult holds each pony. Children wait outside the rope until called. Use the soft brush shown by the helper. Stand at the side when the adult invites you. Do not go behind the pony. Return brushes to the clean tray, not the food bucket.

questions.prompt: A friend steps past the rope before being called. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A叫名前绳外等；B马后明禁；C取绳非安排。

questions.prompt: A friend wants to hold the pony alone. You say, "____"
options: Let the adult hold the pony.
Tie the pony to your bag.
questions.explanation: B成人牵持；A独持、C绑包违分工。

questions.prompt: A friend chooses a hard brush from another box. You say, "____"
options: Use the food bucket as a brush.
Use the soft brush the helper showed us.
questions.explanation: C指定帮手示软刷；A任意非规定；B桶非刷。

questions.prompt: A friend walks towards the pony’s back. You say, "____"
options: Stay at the side with the adult.
Put the tray behind it and sit there.
questions.explanation: A成人邀请侧面，非后方；B/C均违不去马后限制。

questions.prompt: The visit ends. A friend puts a brush in the food bucket. You say, "____"
options: Return the brush to the clean tray.
Put it in your lunch box.
questions.explanation: B刷回净盘非食桶；A留食桶、C饭盒均混用途。

units.title: 音乐社里的十段完整语境

materials.title: Music Club Ten Sentences 031
materials.text: Choose the word or reply that fits each complete music-club situation.

questions.prompt: The two drums ____ different sounds. We try each one.
questions.explanation: A drums复数用have现在谓语；B has单三不配；C having缺be。

questions.prompt: This note is long. Sing it ____, not quickly.
questions.explanation: B slowly与not quickly对应；A饥饿方式不表音长，C square形容词不表演唱方式。

questions.prompt: I know the beat, but I ____ play the flute yet. I need help.
questions.explanation: C不能吹笛且需帮助与but对照；B会与not yet学习缺口矛盾；A am不能接play原形。

questions.prompt: Please keep these small instruments in their ____. Each one has a box.
questions.explanation: A instruments多件各盒，boxes标准复数；B单数不合各有一；C拼写错。

questions.prompt: The choir needs red scarves. Do we choose the green ones? No, ____.
questions.explanation: B红围巾要求明确；A绿色、C不要围巾均反要求。

questions.prompt: The cover says "Sam". This is ____ music book.
questions.explanation: C Sam’s名词所有格限定书；A缺撇号，B单名不表达本句所有关系。

questions.prompt: The song is over. We clap ____ the final note, not during it.
questions.explanation: A after表音结束后；B里面、C下方不表此时间顺序。

questions.prompt: I cannot open the instrument case. ____ you help me, please?
questions.explanation: B Can you help请求能力帮助；A Is不配you且不接help；C Does不配you。

questions.prompt: Let us ____ the beat together.
questions.explanation: C let us后clap原形；A单三、B分词不合。

questions.prompt: The baby is sleeping next door. Keep the music ____.
questions.explanation: A quiet低音不扰睡；B泥、C渴不描述音量。

units.title: 报名读书社时改选一天

materials.title: Reading Club Signup Order 031
materials.text:
Order the dialogue. The fixed opening is: 1. I would like to join the reading club.
A. Yes, the Wednesday group starts at four.
B. We meet on Tuesdays. Can you come then?
C. Please fill in this short form.
D. That works. How do I put my name down?
E. No, I have a class then. Is there another group?
Choose a position from 2 to 6 for every line.

questions.prompt: What position does line A take?
questions.explanation: C第4步答另组请求，提供周三四点；A第2步先问周二；B第3步说明冲突；D第5步才同意问报名；E第6步表格。

questions.prompt: What position does line B take?
questions.explanation: A第2步回应入社意愿给周二并问能否来；B第3步答不能；C第4步替代；D第5步报名问；E第6步填表。

questions.prompt: What position does line C take?
questions.explanation: E第6步回答如何报名，填表；A/B第2第3步时间冲突，C第4步替代，D第5步才提出登记问题。

questions.prompt: What position does line D take?
questions.explanation: D第5步接受新组并问姓名登记；A第2步未给原日，B第3步未提冲突，C第4步才给替代，E第6步应答表格。

questions.prompt: What position does line E take?
questions.explanation: B第3步No回答周二能否来并求另组；A第2步应先给日，C第4步答另组，D第5步接受，E第6步登记。

units.title: 物品用途、表面与植物的词语

materials.title: Use And Description Words 031
materials.text: Choose the word that matches the precise description in each question.

questions.prompt: Which word names something worn around the waist to hold clothing?
questions.explanation: C belt腰带束腰衣；A手套戴手；B毛巾擦水非束衣用品。

questions.prompt: Which word describes the feel of a surface?
questions.explanation: A smooth光滑为表面触感；B饿为生理状态；C明天为时间。

questions.prompt: Which item helps someone see small print more closely?
questions.explanation: B放大镜放大文字；A口哨发声、C食篮盛物非助看工具。

questions.prompt: Which food grows as a part below the soil?
questions.explanation: C potato土下块茎；A苹果、B梨在树上，不是土下所收部位。

questions.prompt: Which action means cleaning hands with water and soap?
questions.explanation: A wash用水皂洗；B借、C测量非清洗动作。

units.title: 公园活动现场的五个应答

materials.title: Park Event Replies 031
materials.text:
Match each question with its best reply. Use each answer once.
A. At the entrance beside the cycle rack.
B. Because the lane is used by delivery carts.
C. The adult wearing the event badge.
D. After the previous group has crossed.
E. Yes, if it stays within the marked area.

questions.prompt: Where do we collect our activity maps?
options: At the entrance beside the cycle rack.
Because the lane is used by delivery carts.
The adult wearing the event badge.
After the previous group has crossed.
Yes, if it stays within the marked area.
questions.explanation: A车架旁入口为领图处；B通道用途原因、C成人、D时机、E区域许可均不答Where。

questions.prompt: Why must our bags stay out of this lane?
options: At the entrance beside the cycle rack.
Because the lane is used by delivery carts.
The adult wearing the event badge.
After the previous group has crossed.
Yes, if it stays within the marked area.
questions.explanation: B送货车用道解释不堵；A位置、C人员、D轮次、E玩球许可不答Why。

questions.prompt: Who can check the number on our booking card?
options: At the entrance beside the cycle rack.
Because the lane is used by delivery carts.
The adult wearing the event badge.
After the previous group has crossed.
Yes, if it stays within the marked area.
questions.explanation: C戴活动牌成人答Who；A地点、B原因、D时机、E区域条件不提供核卡人员。

questions.prompt: When may our group cross the small bridge?
options: At the entrance beside the cycle rack.
Because the lane is used by delivery carts.
The adult wearing the event badge.
After the previous group has crossed.
Yes, if it stays within the marked area.
questions.explanation: D前组过后答过桥轮次；A领图点、B送货原因、C成人、E标区许可均不答When。

questions.prompt: May we use a ball here?
options: At the entrance beside the cycle rack.
Because the lane is used by delivery carts.
The adult wearing the event badge.
After the previous group has crossed.
Yes, if it stays within the marked area.
questions.explanation: E可以但限标区，答用球许可；A领图处、B车道原因、C成人、D桥次不答该活动条件。

units.title: 星星贴纸为什么贴不住

materials.title: Sticker Chart Six Cloze 031
materials.text:
Read the complete story and choose the best word for each numbered gap.
We made a reading chart with star stickers. At first, the stars would not ____1____ on the board. We pressed harder, but they fell off. The teacher asked us to read the ____2____ on the packet. A thin paper layer still covered each sticky back. We had to peel it off ____3____ pressing the star down. We also kept the board ____4____, because water would spoil the paper surface. After the first star worked, we showed the other group ____5____ to do it. We did not need stronger glue; we needed to follow the step we had ____6____.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A stick粘住与fell off相对；B睡、C游不描述贴纸固定问题。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: B读包装说明了解漏步骤；A窗、C云非包装文字指导。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: C先撕背纸再按，before接动名词；A空间、B缺两端不表本步骤先后。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: A干板对照水损纸面；B饿、C重不表示防水条件。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: B show how to do示范方法；A who不接此结构，C why只解释原因不是操作示范。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 6?
questions.explanation: C missed step漏撕背纸；A借步骤、B唱步骤不合所述错误。

materials.title: Charity Walk Shirt Number 031
materials.text: At a charity walk, each participant received a shirt with an entry number. Maya’s shirt showed 80. Her younger brother thought it meant she had finished eightieth. The walk had not even started, and it was not a timed race. The number helped helpers check that registered walkers had reached each rest point. Maya explained this and showed the matching number on her card. The organiser later added "Entry number" above the printed digits on new shirts. At the end, the report counted completed walks, not a ranking from fastest to slowest.

questions.prompt: Maya’s shirt number was her finishing position.
questions.explanation: B正确：entry登记号非名次，未开始且非计时赛；A重复弟弟误解。

questions.prompt: The number helped helpers check walkers at rest points.
questions.explanation: A正确：check registered walkers reached each rest point；B否认用途。

questions.prompt: Maya’s card and shirt had matching numbers.
questions.explanation: A正确：matching on card；B否认识别关系。

questions.prompt: The event ranked every walker by speed.
questions.explanation: B正确：not timed race，报告非速度排名；A改变活动性质。

questions.prompt: Words were added to clarify what the digits represented.
questions.explanation: A正确：加Entry number；B否认标示消歧目的。

units.title: 社区活动室变化的词形

materials.title: Community Room Word Forms 031
materials.text:
Complete every gap using the correct one-word form of the given word.
1. Last spring, our small group ____1____ (grow) herbs near the community room.
2. New wooden ____2____ (shelf) hold the activity materials along one wall.
3. This reusable box is ____3____ (cheap) than buying a new one every week.
4. Look! A soft mat is ____4____ (lie) flat on the floor beside the reading chairs.
5. We placed the glass model ____5____ (gentle; use the conventional adverb ending in -ly) on its stand.

questions.prompt: Gap 1: use GROW.
questions.explanation: 接受grew：Last spring过去时，grow不规则；grow原形、growed错、growing分词均不作过去谓语。

questions.prompt: Gap 2: use SHELF.
questions.explanation: 接受shelves：多件新木架作hold主语需复数，shelf变shelves；shelf单数不合hold，shelfs错，shelveses重复复数。

questions.prompt: Gap 3: use CHEAP.
questions.explanation: 接受cheaper：than费用比较；cheap原级、cheapest最高级、cheapness名词均非比较表语。

questions.prompt: Gap 4: use LIE.
questions.explanation: 接受lying：is lying flat表示平放状态，lie去ie改y加ing；lie原形不成进行，laying需放置宾语，lied说谎过去不合物体平躺义。

questions.prompt: Gap 5: write the conventional adverb ending in -ly from GENTLE.
questions.explanation: 接受gently：本空明确要求GENTLE派生的常规-ly副词。列出的其他形态不满足本题-ly任务约束；这并不声称其在所有英语语境中不合法，也不因缺少明示比较就否定可能的隐含比较。未列形式仍进入复核。

units.title: 共用电脑时的五种具体问法

materials.title: Shared Computer Functions 031
materials.text: Choose the sentence that achieves each stated purpose in a supervised school computer room.

questions.prompt: You saved a drawing but do not know which folder received it. What should you ask?
options: Where was my drawing saved? Could you help me locate it?
Can every folder become a tree?
Why is the sky outside blue?
questions.explanation: A询保存位置求定位；B拟物、C天空原理不找文件。

questions.prompt: You need only page three printed and want to avoid printing the whole document. What should you say?
options: Could you print only page three, please?
questions.explanation: B明确只印第三页；A全印十次反节制目标；C删打印机非输出需求。

questions.prompt: You cannot hear the video clearly and want to ask about captions. What should you ask?
options: Can you hide all the words?
Are captions available for this video?
questions.explanation: C问字幕作为理解渠道；A藏字相反；B所有视频无声不解决当前听不清。

questions.prompt: A tool has created text with a strange date. You want it checked before using it. What should you say?
options: Could we verify this date against the source first?
The tool must be right because it looks neat.
Let us copy it without checking.
questions.explanation: A对来源核日期；B整齐不保真；C不核复制反目的。

questions.prompt: You are about to leave a shared computer and want to confirm your work is saved. What should you ask?
options: May I close every other pupil’s file?
Can we check that my work is saved before I sign out?
Should I unplug the whole room?
questions.explanation: B退出前核自己的保存状态；A关他人文件、C拔全室电不达目标。
